title: The Promises and Pitfalls of LLM Annotations in Dataset Labeling: a Case Study on Media Bias Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on media bias detection and political framing. While it includes a standard Ethics Statement and a minor robustness test (CheckList) that uses religious terms like 'Buddha' and 'Christ' to check for spurious correlations, these are not components of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core topic.
